Keisha (People Ops): FYI Diego's start on Mon; he's remote and told us his state ID renewal is in progress. Can we still complete I-9 Day 1?
Noah (HR Ops): yes, use alternate doc combo (SSN card + gov receipt). For remote hires we require live video verification plus upload of scans within 3 business days.
Diego (New Hire): I can do the Zoom verification at 9am PT. I uploaded the DMV receipt and SSN scan to the secure intake.
Keisha (People Ops): perfect. quick script we use:
```
1) confirm full name and DOB verbally
2) candidate holds each doc to camera, rotate so details visible
3) witness takes timestamped screenshot
4) log doc types in HRIS and set follow-up to collect originals
```
IT Service: we'll provision laptop + corp email Day 1; no admin groups until BG clears.
BG Vendor Bot: background check: CONSENT_RECEIVED (1789999050), ETA 48-72h.
Noah (HR Ops): TL;DR proceed with onboarding and benefits enrollment; mark employee as contingent until BG CLEARED.
Diego (New Hire): thanks all, I'll be on Zoom 9am PT.
Keisha (People Ops): I'll join to witness and update Diego's task when done.
